description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the bounded test-verdict-gated iterate-to-green loop (numeric threshold → judge escalation). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: subjective-craft revision (do-and-judge), one-shot multi-judge review (review-changes), a single test run with no loop, judging a diff without execution, and the deferred live-app Playwright verdict.

queries.q: keep fixing until the tests pass
iterate this change to green, run the suite each time
verify and repair until quality checks pass, then have a judge confirm
loop: run tests, fix failures, re-run, stop when green or after 3 tries
drive this to passing tests but don't let it break anything that was green
is this diff clean — naming, structure, conventions?
queries.note: subjective craft, no executed verdict → do-and-judge / judge-code-quality

queries.q: review my changes before I open the PR
run the test suite once and show me the failures
judge this patch and tell me if it's correct
queries.note: judge reads a diff, no execution loop → do-and-judge

queries.q: loop the Playwright end-to-end tests against the live app until the UI passes
queries.note: live-app verdict is deferred (needs a runtime); not this skill's scope
